412001.name: Salvo
412001.description: Fires a barrage of assault rifle shots, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

412002.name: Special Bullet: ATK Down
412002.description: Fires special bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit will have her ATK temporarily decreased. The special bullets can be intercepted.

412003.name: Laser Shock
412003.description: Fires special lasers, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The Nikke who is hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act. The laser cannons on both flanks can be destroyed and will no longer fire once they are gone.

412005.name: Barrage: Wide Area
412005.description: Fires a volley of rockets, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

412006.name: Barrier
412006.description: Generates a barrier in front of it, defending against Nikkes' attacks.
